name: garuda
description: Checks what AI coding agents change before it lands: impact analysis, architecture rules, and a tamper-evident record. MCP server plus 6 skills.

interface.shortDescription: Guardrails and proof for AI-written code
interface.longDescription: Before an agent edits code, Garuda shows who depends on it and which architecture rules apply. After the edit, it checks the diff and records the verdict in a tamper-evident ledger.
